Valuation technique:
This relates to leasehold land
upon which the manufacturing
plants are set up. These assets
are revalued every 3 to 5 years,
at values, based on valuation
done by Ms Accurate Valuers
Limited on 29th March 2022.
Accurate Valuers Limited is
an accredited independent
valuer and an industry
specialist in valuing these
types of properties. The fair
value of the leasehold land
has been determined based
on comparable transaction
in the market. Additionally,
valuation model in accordance
with that recommended by
the International Valuation
Standard Committee has been
applied.
Significant unobservable inputs:
The right-of-use land
is located in prime
locations within Nairobi’s
industrial area and Dar
es salaam Nyerere road.
